'''Reerookachuck''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], and taken from his home before he could speak. He was raised by [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]], and thus never learned the ways of his culture, and did not interact with other Wookiees until he was seventy. As such Reerochuck used his claws in combat, and would be considered dishonorable by other Wookiees. He was eventually taken captive by a group of slavers from the [[Sord Montok]] corporation. After he was brought aboard the company's shipt [[Sord Montok (starship)|''Sord Montok'']] at [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], Reerookachuck decided it was [[Time/Legends|time]] to escape. He started a riot aboard the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], which led to the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of twenty slavers. After the incident, the [[Unidentified Sord Montok CEO|CEO of Sord Montok]] placed a sixty-five thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] for Reerookachuck's capture.<ref name="BtDF" />
